questions.subtitle: We will never put these in your wardrobe.

answers.hint: One for day, one for after dark

answers.hint: 3 to 5, one for each part of my week

questions.title: With it on, you want to feel…
questions.subtitle: Pick up to two.

list.name: The First Light
list.line: Zest on warm skin. A bright, close scent for the first hour of the day, noticed only by whoever leans in.

list.name: The Sunlit Signal
list.line: Citrus peel, green leaves and a clean trail that walks into the room a step behind you.

list.name: The Bright Entrance
list.line: Sparkling top notes with real staying power. You arrive and the whole room brightens a shade.

list.name: The Quiet Signature
list.line: Clean woods, cool herbs and a whisper of iris. Sharp, composed and kept to your own desk.

list.name: The Sharp Edit
list.line: Crisp aromatics over dry cedar. The scent of someone who answers emails in full sentences.

list.name: The Boardroom Pull
list.line: Structured woods and cold spice with a trail that says the meeting starts when you sit down.

list.name: The Skin Secret
list.line: Soft musk, warm petals and a trace of amber, made for the distance of a whisper.

list.name: The Slow Burn
list.line: Rose, resin and something darker underneath. It lingers on a scarf long after you've left.

list.name: The After-Hours Magnet
list.line: Oud, amber and velvet florals that own the room after dark. Heads turn and nobody can say why.

list.name: The Sweet Confidant
list.line: Vanilla, cream and a pinch of spice worn close. Dessert you keep to yourself.

list.name: The Golden Hour Guest
list.line: Juicy fruit, warm amber and a pop of fizz. You make any table feel like a party.

list.name: The Grand Entrance
list.line: Rum, praline, saffron and leather. Loud in the best way and still there at the last song.

list.name: The Soft Landing
list.line: Lavender, sandalwood and clean musk. A Sunday with nowhere to be, bottled.

list.name: The Cashmere Evening
list.line: Creamy woods and powdery vanilla that warm a room like a lamp turned low.

list.name: The Clean Stride
list.line: Cool water, bright citrus and a snap of ginger. Fresh from the first step to the last.

list.name: The Open Air
list.line: Sea salt, green leaves and wild herbs that trail behind you like wind off the water.

list.name: The Still Point
list.line: Sandalwood, tea and a thread of incense. Close, unhurried and completely your own.

list.name: The Temple Smoke
list.line: Frankincense, myrrh and dry woods drifting through the room like the last minutes of a ritual.
